 Luis Enrique’s Parisians top the UCL table with a 100% record after impressive wins over Slovan Bratislava, Man City and Barcelona. They come into this match off the back of a typically convincing 5-1 thrashing of Le Havre in Ligue 1 on Friday.
 After an encouraging recent run of good domestic form, Iñigo Pérez’s Villarreal crashed to a shock 1-0 loss to a managerless Espanyol side in La Liga on Friday. The Yellow Submarine has so far racked up one win and two losses in this season’s Champions League, the most recent a chaotic 4-3 defeat to Liverpool that saw the Spanish side throw away a two-goal lead.
 More from CNET
 Villarreal takes PSG on Tuesday, Nov. 3, at the Estadio de la Cerámica, with kickoff set for 9 p.m. CEST  local time in Spain. That makes it an 8 p.m. BST start in the UK and a  3 p.m. ET  or  12 p.m. PT  kickoff in the US and Canada. For soccer fans Down Under, it’s a  7 a.m. AEDT  start in Australia on Wednesday.
 How to watch every UEFA Champions League 2026-27 game using a VPN
 If you’re traveling abroad and want to keep up with all the UCL action while away from home, a VPN can help enhance your privacy and security when streaming. 
 Virtual private networks encrypt your traffic and prevent your internet service provider from throttling your speeds, and can also be helpful when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks while traveling, adding an extra layer of protection for your devices and logins. VPNs are legal in many countries, including the US and Canada, and can be used for legitimate purposes such as improving online privacy and security. 
 However, some streaming services may have policies that restrict VPN use for accessing region-specific content. If you’re considering a VPN for streaming, check the platform’s terms of service to ensure compliance. 
 If you choose to use a VPN, follow the provider’s installation instructions to ensure you’re connected securely and in compliance with applicable laws and service agreements. Some streaming platforms may block access when a VPN is detected, so verifying if your streaming subscription allows VPN usage is crucial.

 Livestream Villarreal vs. PSG in the US
 While CBS will be showing select fixtures each week on linear TV, the best option, once again, for American soccer fans looking to watch the Champions League is a Paramount Plus subscription. The streamer has exclusive live English-language broadcast rights in the US for the UEFA Champions League and will be broadcasting every single match, including this one.
 Sarah Tew/CNET 
 Watch the Champions League in the US from $9 a month 
 Paramount Plus 
 Get it now 
 See at Paramount Plus 
 Expert Take 
 Paramount Plus has two main subscription plans in the US: Essential for $9 per month and Premium for $14 per month. Both offer coverage of the Champions League.
 The cheaper Essential option has ads for on-demand streaming and lacks live CBS feeds as well as the ability to download shows to watch offline later. Newcomers to the service can take advantage of a 30-day free trial, while students may qualify for a 25% discount.
 Livestream Villarreal vs. PSG in the UK
 TNT Sports is broadcasting the lion’s share of Champions League games in the UK this season and will be showing this game live on TNT Sports 4.

 Expert Take 
 TNT Sports is offering the lion’s share of Champions League matches exclusively live this season to viewers in the UK. You can access TNT Sports in a number of ways, including as a TV package via Sky Q, Sky Glass, NOW, Virgin Media and EE TV. On top of this, there’s also the option for direct streaming from HBO Max with a plan that includes TNT Sports. Prices currently start at £26 per month.
 Livestream Villarreal vs. PSG in Canada
 If you want to stream UCL games live in Canada, you’ll need to subscribe to DAZN Canada. The service has exclusive broadcast rights to all Champions League matches this season.

 Livestream Villarreal vs. PSG in Australia
 Football fans Down Under can watch UCL matches on streaming service Stan Sport, which once again has exclusive rights to show all 189 Champions League matches live in Australia this season.
